mainEntity.name: What is a detached in-law suite, and how does it function?

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached in-law suite is a standalone residential living space built separately from the main house on the same lot. It generally features its own dedicated entrance, sleeping quarters, a full bathroom, and either a kitchenette or full kitchen setup. Unlike attached additions or interior room conversions, a detached structure provides maximum privacy and noise separation for aging relatives, adult children, or extended guests. Choosing this layout requires evaluating yard space, setbacks, and outdoor utility routing rather than tying directly into interior hallways.
